frozen_fidelity_methodology.status: FROZEN as of this V4 run per instruction 1; must not change after this point
frozen_fidelity_methodology.primary_metric: REQUIRED-ITEMS FIDELITY -- (MATCH + SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT) / (total scored items EXCLUDING Buyer Intelligence and EXCLUDING EXTRA_NOT_REQUIRED items)
frozen_fidelity_methodology.secondary_diagnostic: FLAT-SUM FIDELITY -- (MATCH + SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT) / (total scored items EXCLUDING Buyer Intelligence, INCLUDING EXTRA_NOT_REQUIRED items in the denominator). Reported for continuity with V1-V3's own published numbers; never used as the acceptance metric, because it penalizes genuinely accurate additional content the same as it would penalize an error.
frozen_fidelity_methodology.required_item_denominator_definition: One scored item per named fact/row Deep Verify's report contains, at the same granularity used consistently since V1 (e.g. a whole weight table = 1 item, not 1-per-row). Buyer Intelligence's 1 bundled item is excluded entirely (external layer). Items classified EXTRA_NOT_REQUIRED are excluded from this denominator (present, accurate, additive -- never penalized, never rewarded either).
frozen_fidelity_methodology.critical_gate_items: The items enumerated in the V4 authorization Section 21 (identity/structure, dates, response requirements, evaluation, pricing, commercial) plus the 3 named ambiguity classes (Section 22, non-negotiable, independent of aggregate fidelity).
frozen_fidelity_methodology.match_scoring: MATCH: the Fast-extracted value is identical or trivially reformatted (e.g. date format) from Deep Verify's stated value, with no material difference in meaning or precision.
frozen_fidelity_methodology.semantically_equivalent_scoring: SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT: the same underlying fact, correctly and accurately stated, but in different wording, structure, or level of resolution than Deep Verify's version (e.g. 'Week of October 26' vs 'October 26, 2026').
frozen_fidelity_methodology.extra_facts_treatment: EXTRA_NOT_REQUIRED: real, accurate, source-supported content Fast Analysis surfaced that Deep Verify's report does not contain. Never scored as INCORRECT. Excluded from the required-items denominator so richer, more complete extraction is never penalized the same as an error would be -- but also never inflates the primary metric, so completeness gains must be demonstrated on their own terms (as in this report's dedicated findings), not smuggled into the percentage.
frozen_fidelity_methodology.prose_differences_treatment: Differences in phrasing, sentence structure, or ordering do not by themselves change a MATCH to a SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT or vice versa -- only a difference in the underlying fact (value, scope, completeness) does.
frozen_fidelity_methodology.buyer_intelligence_treatment: Marked UNCHANGED_EXTERNAL_LAYER, excluded entirely from both metrics -- it is a separate, externally-sourced layer this package does not redesign, per the explicit instruction carried since V1.
